headline: S&P 500 falls 3.7% as AI stocks sell off, entering a correction
pages: A sell-off in artificial intelligence stocks on Friday pulled the S&P 500 down 3.7%, its worst weekly loss in more than 18 months. The index is down more than 10% from its Oct. 6 record, which meets the definition of a correction, after a seven-day losing streak. The Nasdaq composite fell 5.3% and is now negative for the year, and the Dow fell 1.9%. Chipmakers including Nvidia, Micron, Broadcom and AMD took the biggest hits. Anthropic, a day after its IPO, fell 9.1%. Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's Kospi each fell more than 5%. NPR reports worries about AI valuations, and midterm wins by candidates seeking a slowdown in data center construction, are weighing on the sector. Source: NPR
